In Re: An application for bail under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal

 Station Case No.451 of 2023 dated 12.04.2023 under Sections
 498A/302/34 of the Indian Penal Code.

)

In Re: Suman Kumar Halder @ Suman Haldar

Public

Prosecutor
 Ms. Faria Hossain
 Ms. Mamata Jana
 ... ... for the State

1. 
It is submitted on behalf of the petitioner that he is in custody for about 110 days.
It is further submitted incident occurred eight years after marriage.
Investigation is complete.
Accordingly, he prays for bail.
2. Learned Advocate for the State opposes the prayer for bail and submits victim-housewife was tortured and committed suicide at the matrimonial home.
3. We have considered the materials on record.
Victim-housewife committed suicide eight years after marriage.
Statutory presumptions under Sections 113A/113B of the Evidence Act are not attracted.
Investigation is complete.
There is no chance of absoncdence of the petitioner.
Under such circumstances and in view of the period of detention suffered by the petitioner, we are of the opinion further detention of the accused/petitioner is not necessary.

4. Therefore, the accused/petitioner, namely Suman Kumar Halder @ Suman Haldar, be released on bail upon furnishing a bond of Rs.10,000/- (Rupees Ten thousand only), with two sureties of like amount each, one of whom must be local, to the satisfaction of the learned Chief Judicial Magistrate,
Murshidabad at Berhampore subject to condition that the said petitioner shall appear before the trial court on every date of hearing until further orders and shall not intimidate witnesses or tamper 498A/302/34 Of The Indian Penal Code.
